ReleaseNotes: This release improves the update experience with redesigned release notes and a new title-bar update notification.
* Added an update-available button to the main window title bar.
- Appears automatically when a newer version is available.
- Remains available after dismissing the update banner.
- Opens the existing release notes and update installation experience.
- Integrates with the native Windows title-bar appearance and behavior.
* Redesigned the Release Notes window for clearer, more structured presentation.
- Improved headings, bullet lists, nested items, and paragraph formatting.
- Added support for both * and • top-level bullet markers.
- Improved compatibility with release notes from earlier versions.
* Unified update notifications across startup, scheduled, and manual update checks.
- All update discovery paths now use the same update-available presentation and behavior.
- Release notes are normalized before being written to the update manifest.
- Prevents malformed control characters from appearing in published release notes.
- Preserves intended inline bullet characters and formatting.
